epg_channel_id.description: XMLTV channel id the guide is read from.

epg_manual.description: The mapping was set manually and is not recomputed.

missing.description: No longer in the provider's list (hidden).

progress.description: 0..1, when the file duration is known.

api_key_hint.description: Masked key (`••••` + last 4 characters); the key itself is never returned.

cc_errors.description: MPEG-TS continuity counter errors (packet loss indicator).

viewer_resyncs.description: Slow viewers skipped ahead to the latest keyframe.

warm.description: Open without viewers (kept for instant zapping).

ChannelPatchBody.description: Partial update; absent fields are unchanged, `null` clears where noted.

epg_channel_id.description: Manual XMLTV channel id; `null` returns to automatic matching.

number.description: Channel number; `null` removes the custom number.

library_ids.description: Libraries the new user may access.

oneOf.description: Limits preset for the new user.

events.description: Subset of requested, approved, declined, available, failed, issue; empty = all.

seasons.description: TV only; omit for all seasons.

audio_index.description: ffprobe stream index of the audio track to use.

item_id.description:
Multi-episode files: the episode being watched (one of the file's `item_ids`); watch
progress is credited to it. Defaults to the file's first item.

preset.description: Built-in preset: web_chrome (default), web_safari, webos, tizen, android_exoplayer.

oneOf.description: Full device profile. Takes precedence over `preset`.

start_s.description: Start position in seconds (transcode sessions start there).

subtitle_index.description: ffprobe stream index of the subtitle track to use.

containers.description: Containers playable directly: mp4, mkv, webm, ts, mov, avi.

library_item_id.description: Library item (movie or show) holding this title, when it is in the library.

oneOf.description: Live download progress when a request is in flight.

DownloadDto.description: One Radarr/Sonarr queue record (also the `items` of the `downloads` WebSocket event).

request_id.description: Reel request this belongs to, if any.

speed_bps.description: Needs a torrent client configured (admin → download clients).

transcode.description: Video encoder used for IPTV transcodes (non-H.264 sources) and whether it fell back.

HwAccelStatus.description: Result of startup probing, exposed in the admin "hw accel status" endpoint.

available.description: Backends that passed a 1-frame test encode, in preference order.

degraded.description: Backends that failed at runtime (ffmpeg exited early) and are no longer used.

library_names.description: Names of the libraries the invite grants.

catchup.description: The provider offers catch-up/archive for this channel.

has_epg.description: An EPG mapping exists for this channel.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

ItemProgressDto.description: Per-item progress inside a request (e.g. one episode / one release).

progress.description: Watch progress 0..1 (movies/episodes with a saved position).

auto_approve.description: Requests are approved and sent to Radarr/Sonarr immediately.

max_bitrate_kbps.description: Bitrate cap in kbit/s (forces transcoding to a lower bitrate).

device_id.description: Stable per-install id; logging in again from the same device replaces its session.

expires_at.description: Session expiry (unix seconds); extended on use.

token.description:
Opaque bearer token: send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
(or `?token=` on the `/events` WebSocket).

library_ids.description: Visible library ids; absent = all libraries (admin).

item_ids.description:
Multi-episode files (`S01E02E03`): ids of every episode item stored in this file, in
episode order. Absent for ordinary files. Pass the episode being watched as `item_id` to
`/playback/{file}/decide` so progress is credited to it.

events.description: Events delivered to this target; empty = all.

disabled.description: Disabling signs the user out everywhere.

library_ids.description: Replaces the set of accessible libraries.

oneOf.description: Replaces all limits (omitted fields become unlimited).

password.description: Admin password reset; signs the user out everywhere.

allOf.description: The same card shape as discovery (status, progress, `library_item_id`, …).

credits.description: Filmography, newest first (cast preferred over crew for the same title).

video_index.description: ffprobe indexes of the streams that are used (None if absent).

ProgressDto.description: Live progress of a request (same data as the `request_progress` WebSocket event, plus detail).

current.description: This is the session making the request.

needs_setup.description: True until the first admin account has been created.

url.description: Playlist URL (m3u) or Xtream server base URL.

open_connections.description: Upstream connections open right now (live + warm).

refresh_interval.description: Minutes between refreshes; `null` = default (12 h); 0 = manual only.

password.description: Omit to keep the current password.

channels.description: Channels found (M3U: all; Xtream: live streams).

epg_url.description: EPG URL advertised by the playlist.

oneOf.description: Converted to WebVTT and served separately (`/subs/{streamId}.vtt`).
Rendered into the video (forces a video transcode).
Client renders the embedded track itself (direct play only).

url.description: WebVTT URL; absent for image subtitles (PGS/VobSub) which can only be burned in.

image.description: Image formats the client can render natively: pgs, vobsub. Empty ⇒ burn-in needed.

text.description: Text formats the client can render natively: vtt, srt, ass.

fell_back_to_software.description: The hardware encoder failed at runtime; software encoding is used instead.

preset.description: Built-in device preset (decides which codecs HLS may copy).

url.description:
Signed URL: `stream.ts` (passthrough) or `index.m3u8` (HLS). Valid for the configured
signed-URL lifetime; the session itself ends shortly after the player disconnects.

api_key.description: Omit to keep the current key.

library_ids.description: Libraries the user may access (ignored for admins, who see everything).

oneOf.description: File has no usable video stream (audio-only).

codec.description: Normalised codec name: h264, hevc, vp9, av1, mpeg2video …

hdr.description: HDR formats decodable *and displayed* as HDR.

max_level.description: Highest level in ffprobe notation (H.264 4.1 = 41, HEVC 5.1 = 153). `None` = any.

event.description: Webhook event type as understood by the server (`Grab`, `Download`, …).

scanned_paths.description: Paths that were re-scanned into the library.

bearer.description: Opaque session token from /auth/login. Media endpoints (direct, stream, subs, images) also accept a signed URL (`exp`, `u`, `sig` query).
